description: This file defines an internal partial class MemoryAdapterReceiver<TSerializer> in the Orleans.Providers namespace. The class implements IQueueAdapterReceiver and manages queuing operations such as initializing, retrieving messages asynchronously, and shutting down, specific to in-memory stream processing. It interacts with various Orleans stream components, handles task management for message dequeuing, and monitors operations via injected monitoring interfaces.

classes.name: MemoryAdapterReceiver`1
classes.description: An internal class implementing IQueueAdapterReceiver for in-memory stream message management, supporting message retrieval, shutdown, and monitoring functionalities tailored to Orleans stream infrastructure.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver, tracks the initialization event, and completes immediately.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves up to maxCount messages from the queue, creating batch containers, monitoring read performance, and handling exceptions.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: A placeholder method indicating messages have been delivered; currently completes immediately without operation.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Performs shutdown procedures, awaiting pending tasks, and tracking shutdown metrics with error handling.

methods.name: LogErrorGetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: A partial method for logging errors occurring in GetQueueMessagesAsync.
